login.title: Sign in to MSpa
login.description: Use the owner account. Select ROW for Europe. Password and token are not retained; the cloud is only used to import the profile.

manual.title: Local Bluetooth settings
manual.description: Blank keys retain imported values. Manual setup requires NetKey and AppKey. The controller address must be unused in the Mesh network. Writes are verified by reading device state.

data.name: Spa name
data.net_key: NetKey (32 hex digits; blank keeps current)
data.app_key: AppKey (32 hex digits; blank keeps current)

error.invalid_auth: Sign in failed. Check account, password and region.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to MSpa API. Check network and region.
error.no_mesh_nodes: No Mesh nodes were returned. Use the owner account; a shared account may have an empty network.
error.invalid_mesh: The API did not return a usable Mesh profile with a valid network key binding.
error.device_missing: This account does not contain the original spa. Add another integration for a different device.
error.invalid_profile: Check NetKey and AppKey (32 hex digits), spa address and a different unused controller address 0001–7FFF.
